messages.content:
You draft show-cause notices for a wetlands regulator in West Bengal, India.

You will be given (a) a water-loss event confirmed from satellite data, and
(b) the verbatim text of statutory provisions that were retrieved from the source
instruments for you.

ABSOLUTE RULES:
1. You may cite ONLY the provisions supplied to you, using exactly the citation
   strings given. Do not cite any other rule, section, act, judgment or authority,
   even if you are confident it exists. If a provision you want is not in the list,
   write around its absence.
2. Do not paraphrase a provision as though it were its text. When you state what
   the law requires, quote it.
3. Do not assert any fact that is not in the event data — no ownership, no names,
   no dates of construction, no intent. Where the notice needs a fact you were not
   given, write a bracketed blank like [name of occupier] for the officer to fill.
4. Do not state a conclusion of law. The notice asks the recipient to show cause;
   it does not find them in breach.

Format — plain text, this structure, no markdown:
  reference line, date line
  addressee block
  Subject line
  1. The facts observed (satellite measurement, dates, area)
  2. The provisions engaged (quoted, with citation)
  3. What the recipient is required to do, and by when
  4. Signature block
Keep it under 450 words.

EVENT (confirmed by satellite measurement, not by you)
Pond reference: EKW_00032 (Pond near GP Block)
Mouza: GP Block
Ward / block: Rajarhat
Approximate coordinates: 22.55718, 88.445491
Site: East Kolkata Wetlands, Ramsar site no. 1208
Period observed: 2024-12-01 to 2025-12-01
Water surface expected for the season: 9.73 ha
Water surface actually observed: 3.18 ha
Reduction: 67 per cent (6.55 ha)
Seasonal variation already accounted for: yes
Recovered since: no
Surface condition now: Structures or hard surface now visible

ADDRESSEE: [name of occupier / owner — unknown]
ISSUING OFFICER: [officer name], [designation]
DATE: 2026-08-28

PROVISIONS RETRIEVED FOR YOU — cite only these:

[Rule 4(2)(i)] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017
"(i) conversion for non-wetland uses including encroachment of any kind;"

[Rule 4(2)(vi)] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017
"(vi) any construction of a permanent nature except for boat jetties within fifty metres from the mean high
flood level observed in the past ten years calculated from the date of commencement of these rules;
and,"

[Rule 2(1)(i)] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017
"(i)    “wise use of wetlands” means maintenance of their ecological character, achieved through implementation
of ecosystem approach within the context of sustainable development;
(j)    “zone of influence” means that part of the catchment area of the wetland or wetland complex,
developmental activities in which induce adverse changes in ecosystem structure, and ecosystem services."

[Rule 4] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017
"4.    Restrictions of activities in wetlands.—(1) The wetlands shall be conserved and managed in accordance with the
principle of 'wise use' as determined by the Wetlands Authority."

response:
Memo No: [reference number]
Date: 2026-08-28

To,
[name of occupier / owner — unknown]
Location: Mouza: GP Block, Ward / block: Rajarhat, Approximate coordinates: 22.55718, 88.445491, Pond reference: EKW_00032 (Pond near GP Block), Site: East Kolkata Wetlands, Ramsar site no. 1208

Subject: Show-cause notice regarding water-loss event and site conditions at pond reference EKW_00032.

1. The facts observed: Satellite measurement confirms that at pond reference EKW_00032 (Pond near GP Block), located at Mouza: GP Block, Ward / block: Rajarhat, approximate coordinates 22.55718, 88.445491, within the East Kolkata Wetlands (Ramsar site no. 1208), the water surface expected for the season was 9.73 ha, but the water surface actually observed during the period observed from 2024-12-01 to 2025-12-01 was 3.18 ha. This constitutes a reduction of 67 per cent (6.55 ha). Seasonal variation has already been accounted for. The reduction has not been recovered since, and structures or hard surface are now visible on the surface condition now.

2. The provisions engaged:
Under "[Rule 4] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017":
"4. Restrictions of activities in wetlands.—(1) The wetlands shall be conserved and managed in accordance with the principle of 'wise use' as determined by the Wetlands Authority."

Under "[Rule 2(1)(i)] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017":
"(i) “wise use of wetlands” means maintenance of their ecological character, achieved through implementation of ecosystem approach within the context of sustainable development;
(j) “zone of influence” means that part of the catchment area of the wetland or wetland complex, developmental activities in which induce adverse changes in ecosystem structure, and ecosystem services."

Under "[Rule 4(2)(i)] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017":
"(i) conversion for non-wetland uses including encroachment of any kind;"

Under "[Rule 4(2)(vi)] — Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017":
"(vi) any construction of a permanent nature except for boat jetties within fifty metres from the mean high flood level observed in the past ten years calculated from the date of commencement of these rules; and,"

3. What the recipient is required to do, and by when: You are required to show cause in writing, supported by relevant documents, why action should not be taken regarding the observed conditions at the site. Your written response must be submitted to the undersigned by [date/time by when to respond].

4. Signature block:
[officer name], [designation]
For the Wetlands Regulator, West Bengal
